name: smartshoplab
description: SmartShopLab — Laboratorio de pruebas e-commerce omnicanal con IA

scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w backend" "npm run dev -w web-frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build -w backend && npm run build -w web-frontend
scripts.test:api-postman: mkdir -p tests/api-integration/reports && newman run tests/api-integration/smartshoplab.postman_collection.json -e tests/api-integration/local.postman_environment.json --reporters cli,json --reporter-json-export tests/api-integration/reports/newman.json; e=$?; npx tsx tests/api-integration/write-newman-html.ts tests/api-integration/reports/newman.json tests/api-integration/reports/newman-report.html "SmartShopLab — Newman API"; exit $e
scripts.test:api-postman:fail: mkdir -p tests/api-integration/reports && newman run tests/api-integration/smartshoplab-demo-fail.postman_collection.json -e tests/api-integration/local.postman_environment.json --reporters cli,json --reporter-json-export tests/api-integration/reports/newman-demo-fail.json; e=$?; npx tsx tests/api-integration/write-newman-html.ts tests/api-integration/reports/newman-demo-fail.json tests/api-integration/reports/newman-demo-fail-report.html "SmartShopLab — Newman API (Demo FAIL)"; exit $e
